reviews.review:
A difficult rogue-like with an amazing soundtrack and lots of randomised power ups to keep things interesting. Its very addictive and well worth getting if you enjoy a challenge.

Multiplayer is amazing but you need to arrange the game beforehand due to lack of matchmaking. It also has a habit of crashing in the middle of a game, especially when there are multiple bosses or someone is using an item that causes a lot of things to happen on the screen at once. A few fixes could make the world of difference, but at least this doesn't affect the single player experience.

Best game ever made. The developers must have made a transaction with North Korea to obtain nuclear warheads, because this game is the bomb. Plain and simple 10/10 nothing to it, best game in existence.

Continuously challenging even after getting 13 of 15 achievments <.< the last two i keep forgetting to do, click to go back to previous levels and forget again >..< 
Great game, will be playing Much More of it

Quite possibly one of the best rougelikes I have ever played. Every unlockable character plays differently, with thoughtfully designed strengths and weaknesses. All the collectible items available are fun to use and accrue, creating some ridiculously fun overpowered combinations the likes I haven't seen since The Binding of Isaac. The art style may seem basic at first, but the animations created from such a small zoomed out pixelated format is really rather impressive. I must say the soundtrack is all kinds of awesome too and quite reminiscent of FTL in places, but with some really fun guitar riffs.

Only downside is a limited number of possible bosses for a roguelike and a bug which can has caused me to fall through the game world a few times. Luckily that particular bug seems to only occur for me during the very first level and simply restarting solved the issue.
